name: Kiskunmajsa (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the town arms of Kiskunmajsa (a crowned blue and green shield with a white lamb and crossed sabres within a yellow frame) above the name KISKUNMAJSA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Kiskunmajsa arms with crown and frame
